query:
ALTER TABLE `users`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `last_signed_in` timestamp DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `login_method` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'google';

ALTER TABLE `agencies`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `trial_ends_at` timestamp DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `owner_user_id` int DEFAULT NULL;

ALTER TABLE `clients`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `subscription_plan` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `onboarding_completed` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

ALTER TABLE `appointments`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `scheduled_at` timestamp DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `duration_minutes` int DEFAULT 60,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `zoom_link` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `outcome` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `no_show_reason` text DEFAULT NULL;

ALTER TABLE `call_logs`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `lead_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `agency_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `vapi_call_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `assistant_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `phone_number` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `recording_url` text DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `outcome` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `cost` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `started_at` timestamp DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `ended_at` timestamp DEFAULT NULL;

ALTER TABLE `team_notifications`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `priority` enum('low','normal','high','urgent') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal';
